scope: Stable individual allocation and durable shared-clock precision in the existing player envelope
retainedInvariants: Same storage key, one writer, max 65536 serialized bytes and max depth 12
Exact schema allowlists and recursive forensic-payload rejection
Existing wallet, inventory, cage placements, progression and battle economy slices
Active unresumable battle save refusal and atomic wallet/receipt serialization
Manual Save and Save and Quit only; no background, clock or result automatic checkpoint
A failed save retains the previous durable checkpoint; retry rebuilds current app state

instanceIdentity.nextSequence: positive safe integer greater than every surviving allocated ID suffix; never reduced during current-schema normalization

migration.v1: Validate exact v1 shape, preserve all player slices, add empty battle economy and derive allocation mark from surviving IDs
migration.v2: Validate exact v2 shape including battle economy, preserve its wallet/receipt, derive allocation mark from surviving IDs
migration.v3: Require and validate instanceIdentity; reject rewound or malformed allocation marks
migration.nestedRaisingString: Outer migration preserves the exact original Raising serialized string; the existing R2 loader independently verifies its old schema/digest before migrating
migration.continue: Validate restored raw instance conflicts before replacing an open session. Duplicate identities and conflicting starter/resident species reject Continue
migration.legacyDeletedHistory: Cannot recover IDs deleted before a legacy checkpoint; preserve observed IDs without renumbering or invented history

raisingPayload.missingLegacyDate: Preserve null year/season/day knowledge according to the validated payload version; never infer dates from savedAt or real-world time
raisingPayload.load: Preserve accepted domain precision; establish fresh browser elapsed baseline without offline growth
raisingPayload.save: Next successful manual save writes current outer v3 plus canonical Raising payload v4

limits: Engineering identity and precision do not establish original persistent creature stats or growth writers
Original full save timing and all scene/modal clock rules remain partially traced
No player battle roster, original capture, food consumption or evolution is implemented by this schema change
